notes: All financial base values refer to kommunen. Assets are buildings/infrastructure plus machinery, excluding work in progress.

Net operating cost excluding depreciation = reported 3203 minus 180 = 3023. Rounded gross expenses 3775 minus operating revenue 751 give 3024; the -1 mnkr component reconciliation is explicit. cashCost is a legacy field name for accrual net operating cost, not observed cash flow.
2330 + 987 - 3203 + 15 - 21 - 4 = 104; published result is 105 after rounding. The 25 mnkr total financial expense is split into 21 interest and 4 remaining expense (including a rounding residual).
Births and deaths are observed; mortality by age and age-boundary flows are modelling assumptions.

Published 2025 cohort counts sum to 43,139, whereas published total is 43,131. Cohorts are proportionally reconciled to the published total; observedPopulation preserves the original counts. No cause is assumed for this discrepancy.

Interest-rate default is a scenario proxy: 21 mnkr interest divided by closing bank debt 1040 mnkr; it is not a reported average borrowing rate. Pension cash payments default to pension expense until a separate payment path is supplied.
assumptionStatus: Illustrative, not SKR or Motala forecasts. Aggregate operating components are sourced; service weights, adaptation, equalisation, revenue growth, pension growth and pension cash payments require calibration. Pension expenses are not reduced by productivity. 65+ remains too broad for production care forecasts.

operatingAccounts.definition: Positive expense magnitudes. Other operating expense = 3775 - 2288 - 190. Reported net operating cost excluding depreciation = 3203 - 180 = 3023; rounded gross components give 3024, reconciled by -1 mnkr. These are accrual expenses and revenues, not cash payments.
